title: Build a managing or managed tenant (MSP build)
purpose: Build a managing tenant (an MSP's own PIM Manager that publishes a signed baseline) or a managed tenant (a customer's PIM Manager that pulls it) end to end from one configuration file of ids and names. Without -Apply it only prints the plan.
whenToRun: When an MSP sets up its managing tenant, and when a managed tenant is set up (the guided install runs it for a managed tenant with an enrollment key). Order: build the managing tenant, build the managed tenant (it prints its subnet id), add that id to the managing tenant's config and re-run -From network-<n>. Run it without -Apply (or with -WhatIf) first.

runAs.name: Owner
runAs.why: The hosting step creates the resources and assigns Azure roles to the identities (Contributor + User Access Administrator is the equivalent).

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator
runAs.why: Microsoft Graph application permissions for the tick, Manager, publish and pull identities; members of the role-assignable SQL admin group. Global Administrator also works.

runAs.name: Application Administrator
runAs.why: The Manager's sign-in app registration and the Invardia Support app's ownerships (Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy).

runAs.name: Groups Administrator
runAs.why: The SQL admin group and the Manager's members group.

runAs.name: Exchange Administrator
runAs.why: Only when the mail sender is provisioned by this build.

runAs.name: Signed in to az as yourself (no deployIdentity in the config), or the certificate deploy identity named in the config
runAs.scope: the tenant and subscription in the config
runAs.why: The build refuses another tenant, another subscription, a signed-in service principal, and any variable that would make a step authenticate as somebody else. The config may hold no secret.

changes.object: the enrollment of this managed tenant (only with an enrollment key; step enroll)
changes.why: Invardia creates the environment, signs the licence, issues an install key and returns the managing tenant's bundle address and signing key ids.
changes.undo: Ask the managing company / Invardia support to remove the environment.

changes.object: the whole hosting (step hosting = Invoke-PimDeployAll.ps1 -Scenario S3 or S6): resource group, network, registry, Log Analytics, SQL, Container Apps environment, the Manager, the tick / bootstrap / updater jobs, the sign-in app, the SQL admin group, schema, mail sender, code
changes.why: Each tenant runs its own PIM Manager in its own subscription.
changes.undo: Delete the resource group; see https://invardia.com/docs/pim/scripts/Invoke-PimDeployAll/ for every object.

changes.object: tenant Key Vault + the bootstrap identity's read grant (step keyvault, only when keyVaultName + bootstrapAppId are set)
changes.why: The managing tenant's own vault.

changes.object: the tick and Manager identities and the Invardia Support app (step sqlgroup; Initialize-PimSqlAdminGroup.ps1)
changes.why: They reach the store through the one admin group.

changes.object: the tick identity (engine set) and the Manager identity (read-only set) (step access; Initialize-PimHostingAccess.ps1)
changes.permission: Microsoft Graph application permissions: the engine set incl. RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory, AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All, Application.Read.All, RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Defender, DeviceManagementRBAC.ReadWrite.All, AccessReview.Read.All (appRoleAssignments); the read-only set for the Manager; never a tenant-wide Mail.Send
changes.why: The engine applies access; the Manager reads.

changes.object: the Manager identity
changes.why: The Manager may start the engine (Run now / commit).

changes.object: the Manager identity (step access; Initialize-PimHostingAccess.ps1; verified and repaired by the end-of-install check)
changes.why: The Environment report reads the installation's own architecture (apps, jobs, registry, SQL, Key Vault, network).
changes.undo: Remove the role assignment (the Environment report then shows the architecture as not readable).

changes.object: the tick identity
changes.permission: Reader (+ User Access Administrator only when opted in)
changes.why: Azure discovery across subscriptions.

changes.object: pim.Settings SchedulerTickJobId, the scenario, the licence + install key (steps access, scenario, licence; Set-PimScenario.ps1, Set-PimLicense.ps1)
changes.why: The environment knows its engine job, its role in the MSP pair and its licence.

changes.object: the Invardia Support app (step supportaccess when support.appId is set; Grant-PimSupportAccess.ps1)
changes.permission: troubleshoot: a contained database user (CREATE USER) with db_datareader + VIEW DEFINITION; setup: also member of grp-pim-sql-admins and owner (owners/$ref) of PIM's own app registrations and groups
changes.why: Invardia support can help (and at 'setup' repair).

changes.object: managing tenant registry schema: platform.Tenants, pim.CentralAdmins, targeting columns; one row per managed tenant with its ring and tags (steps registry, register-<n>; Initialize-PimMasterRegistry.ps1, Register-PimManagedTenant.ps1)
changes.why: Which tenants the managing tenant publishes to.
changes.undo: Remove the tenant rows in the Manager.

changes.object: managing tenant: storage service endpoint on its subnet, the signed-baseline storage account + container (anonymous blob read; its own subnet allowed, then firewall Deny), a storage network rule per managed tenant subnet (steps publishnetwork, storage, network-<n>; New-PimBaselineStorage.ps1, Set-PimBaselineNetworkAccess.ps1)
changes.why: Public-but-signed: managed tenants read the bundle over a network the firewall names; trust is the signature.
changes.undo: Delete the storage account; remove the network rules.

changes.object: the publish job's managed identity (and the signed-in builder for the first upload)
changes.why: The publish job writes the signed bundle.

changes.object: a non-exportable RSA signing key in Key Vault (step signingkey; New-PimBaselineSigningKey.ps1); the key id is printed for the managed tenants to pin
changes.why: The bundle is signed; managed tenants refuse a bundle that does not verify.
changes.undo: Disable / delete the key (managed tenants then refuse new bundles).

changes.object: the publish job's managed identity (and the builder to read the key)
changes.permission: Key Vault Crypto User (Key Vault Reader for the builder; Key Vault Administrator or Key Vault Crypto Officer are what the person needs to create the key)
changes.why: The publish job signs with the key; nobody can export it.

changes.object: the publish job ca-pim-publish (daily + on demand, system identity) and its first run (steps publishjob, publish; Deploy-PimBaselinePublishJob.ps1, Start-PimBaselinePublish.ps1)
changes.why: The managing tenant publishes the signed baseline in the cloud, no signing host.

changes.object: the publish job's identity
changes.permission: a database user with db_datareader (db_datawriter / db_ddladmin / db_owner are refused for it)
changes.why: It reads what to publish, nothing else.
changes.undo: DROP USER for the publish job.

changes.object: managed tenant: storage service endpoint on its subnet (the subnet id is printed for the managing tenant), the pull job (plain blob URL, signature-verified, system identity) with AcrPull on the registry (steps pullnetwork, downlink; Initialize-PimBaselinePullNetwork.ps1, Deploy-PimDownlinkJob.ps1)
changes.why: The managed tenant pulls the bundle; retraction is report-only.
changes.undo: Delete the pull job; remove the service endpoint.

changes.object: the pull job's managed identity
changes.permission: the engine set of Microsoft Graph application permissions (incl. RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory) + member of grp-pim-sql-admins
changes.why: It applies the managing tenant's baseline in this tenant.
changes.undo: Remove the app role assignments and the membership.

changes.object: private networking options (only when configured): the SQL build window AllowSetupHost (opened and closed by the build), a private endpoint for the bundle store, privatelink DNS (Set-PimSqlBuildWindow.ps1, Set-PimBaselinePrivateEndpoint.ps1, Initialize-PimBaselinePrivateDns.ps1, Close-PimSqlSetupHostRule.ps1)
changes.why: Private stores are reached only while the build needs them.
changes.undo: Remove the private endpoint / DNS records; the firewall rule is removed by the build's last step.

changes.object: self-service managed tenants: the bundle facts (address, signing key ids) and a managed tenant's pull subnet id (steps enrollment, enrollreport; Publish-PimEnrollmentFacts.ps1)
changes.why: Invardia hands them to the other side of the pair.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.help: Master (managing tenant, S3) or Slave (managed tenant, S6).

parameters.name: ConfigPath
parameters.help: The build config: ids and names only (no secret is accepted).

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Build. Without it (or with -WhatIf) the plan and the operator steps are printed.

parameters.name: UpdateSourceUrl
parameters.help: The release feed URL template (a credential: never printed or saved).

parameters.name: UpdateSourceUrlFile
parameters.help: A one-line file holding the release feed URL.

parameters.name: EnrollmentKey
parameters.help: Managed tenant: the Invardia enrollment key (never printed or stored).

parameters.name: EnrollmentTimeoutSeconds
parameters.help: How long to wait for the signed licence.

parameters.name: ImageTag
parameters.default: the config's imageTag, else the running image on a resume
parameters.help: The image tag the build uses.

parameters.name: InvardiaInstallToken
parameters.help: Tracked install: every step is reported to Invardia.

parameters.name: OnStep
parameters.help: Callback per step event (the guided install's reporter).

readsOnly: The config (validated: no key or value may look like a credential), the plan (engine/msp/PIM-MspBuild.ps1), the signed-in identity (az account show, a token's tenant and user-ness), the managed identities' object ids when a step needs them, the running Manager image on a resume.
Directory roles named only to say who must run a step it cannot: Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, Application Administrator, Groups Administrator, Exchange Administrator.
The end-of-install check (Confirm-PimInstall.ps1) reads every result back; a required line that would fail ends the build with its fix.
network: the Azure CLI extension index (azcliextensionsync.blob.core.windows.net): az installs its 'containerapp' extension once when missing (hosting step) -- az's own download, checked against the index's sha256
whatIf: Prints the plan (every step with the script it runs, NOT RUNNABLE steps with the reason), the operator steps, and one 'What if:' line per step naming what it would change and in which tenant and subscription. -WhatIf wins over -Apply: no claim at Invardia, no sign-in, nothing created or granted. Each step's own script can be previewed with its -WhatIf.
undo: Delete each tenant's resource group (export the database first) and the Entra objects the hosting step created; on a managing tenant also the baseline storage, the signing key and the publish job, and the managed tenants' rows; Grant-PimSupportAccess.ps1 -Remove for the Invardia Support app. See each change's undo.
